revision_reason: R2 stopped the social predictor at 80 epochs although its best validation loss was still improving, and selected action checkpoints with a 100-step loss although the registered decision metric uses 16 steps. R3 repairs only those convergence and selection defects.
authorized_scope: B-source M3 convergence repair only; P, T, combinations, M4, M5, B0-H and formal policy training remain unauthorized

repair_training_data.rule: Reuse the unchanged 36 train and 12 tune successes per task. Never read or reuse the R2 test split.

collection.selection: first 12 successful episodes beginning at the frozen first-unused candidate index
collection.test_visibility: Do not collect a new test unless the tune screen passes. After collection, hash the merged manifest and all fixed checkpoints before the dedicated test command can read any test file.

controls.rule: Neither E0, label-shuffled nor time/phase-only may rescue B. Both B and B_hat must beat label-shuffled on the new test with a positive 95% CI lower bound.

action_probe.architecture: LayerNorm(input) -> Linear(input,256) -> SiLU -> Linear(256,256) -> SiLU -> Linear(256,800)
action_probe.training_loss: masked MSE over up to 100 future steps
action_probe.checkpoint_selection_metric: six-task macro episode NRMSE over exactly the first 16 future steps
action_probe.randomness: one unchanged frozen initialization seed and dataset-sampler seed, matched across conditions

social_predictor.crossfit_rule: For every outer fold, select epoch count on a disjoint episode-level inner validation split, refit on all outer-train episodes for that count, and predict only the untouched outer-held episodes.
social_predictor.final_rule: Fit all train episodes and select on tune; test remains unread.

metric.primary: episode NRMSE over the first 16 future action steps, macro-averaged equally over six tasks
metric.effect: (HC error - condition error) / HC error; positive is better

power_audit.data: tune only; no test path may be opened

tune_screen.failure_rule: If any check fails, stop without collecting or opening a new test.

acceptance.decision_scope: A B pass authorizes only B to enter M4. It does not unlock B-core and never authorizes formal training; B-core still requires M4 and M5.
